page.layout: One column of running text, with the French paragraph at full width at the top. Below it a centred heading "EPIST. XLI.", then an argument line, a salutation in italic and roman, and the body paragraph in the main column. A catchword sits at the right below the last line. No margin notes.

main_text.p: Le Cardinal Capucin frere du Pape est fait grand Penitencier par la mort du Card. Borghese, qui a laisse de grands benefices,,dont le Card. Barberin n'en veut rien prendre si non l'Archiprestré de St. Pierre.
main_text.head: EPIST. XLI.
Godofredus Vendelinus Joh. Morino. Quærit, quis sit Rabbi Eliezer, & de ejus Libro, Antiqua & Nova Judæo-rum Chronologia, ac supputandi Ra-tio.
main_text.p: Viro undequaque Eruditissimo J. Morino, C.O. Presb. Godofr. Vendelinus, S.P.

DUdum est, Eruditissime Morine, cùm pervagata terrarum orbem prolixa tua in rem litterariam merita, & amorem apud omnes doctos excitarunt tui, & post illos admiratione defixum me sic attinuerunt hactenus, ut quamquam visendi tui desiderio incredibilem in modū ardeam, pudore tamen magis retinear,

page.notes: The French paragraph uses long-s forms (est, laissé, si, Archiprestré), rendered with plain s. The double comma in "benefices,,dont" is as printed. The catchword "quàm" is at the right below the last line. A digitiser's banner ("Digitized by G...") at the bottom right was left out. No doubtful readings.
